name: Spria
notes: Turael's daughter; assigns the same task list as Turael plus sourhogs, which no other master assigns.
Cannot change a task from another master into an easier one - she directs players to Turael/Aya for that - so unlike Turael she never resets the task streak.
Completed tasks award no points but still count toward the four completions needed before points start accruing, and they advance the streak toward milestone bonuses.
Block list is shared with Turael/Aya.
Tasks she assigns cannot be skipped through Turael.
